rustsolid-foundation.responsibility: Coordinates, tolerance configuration and base errors

rustsolid-predicates.responsibility: Robust orientation and filtered numeric decisions

rustsolid-geometry.responsibility: Analytic curves/surfaces and UV chart domains

rustsolid-uv.responsibility: Source-neutral analytic UV arrangement and polygon-only geo adapter

rustsolid-topology.responsibility: Canonical B-rep graph, geometry attachments, scoped IDs and invariants

rustsolid-construct.responsibility: Source primitive B-rep builders (box/cylinder/extrude, bores); source parameters live in rustsolid-source

rustsolid-imprint.responsibility: Trimmed source-face intersections, G1 graph and provenance

rustsolid-classification.responsibility: G2/G3 cell and whole-solid material classification

rustsolid-validation.responsibility: Independent G8b source-only verified interval implemented; actual-result flux and general certification pending

rustsolid-assembly.responsibility: G4 source-bound topology changes, patch stitching and staged candidate B-rep

rustsolid-boolean.responsibility: Narrow proof-bound G8 tilted one-wall sealed candidate; general Boolean/document integration pending

rustsolid-modeling.responsibility: Euler operations, structural/carrier edits and feature intents

rustsolid-meshing.responsibility: Derived face-owned display mesh and facet certificates

rustsolid-document.responsibility: Atomic in-memory restricted G8 document commit/undo/redo/face handles; persistent archive and generic naming pending

rustsolid-archive.responsibility: Versioned feature archive and reopen by recomputation

rustsolid-qualification.responsibility: Independent G4–G8 fixtures, metamorphic tests and benchmarks
